scope: Production real-domain six-context exercise only. Broad full-site feature acceptance is indexed in the parent acceptance scope and stable handoff.

areas.purpose: Capture an actionable task with enough context and preserve pending input.
areas.actual_closure: Real UI creates dated and undated tasks; edits multiline description; main save retains pending child exactly once.
areas.evidence: Six native reports and created-db/edited-db JSON.

areas.purpose: Retain completed history while keeping active work visible.
areas.actual_closure: Complete dated task; list returns active undated task; 1/2 completed remains stored.
areas.evidence: Six reports, saved raw DB and final reloaded workspace.

areas.purpose: Plan deadlines, see chronological work, and review completions that lead to a useful next action.
areas.actual_closure: Real top/sidebar/bottom view navigation; dated+undated calendar/timeline records and one completion shown in stats.
areas.evidence: Original strict view assertions; selected native public screenshots.

areas.purpose: Maintain a coherent workspace and make data/help controls findable.
areas.actual_closure: Four themes; dark/light; Chinese/English; appearance/data/experience/cleanup/help navigation and return preserve tasks.
areas.evidence: Six reports; selected Chinese dark settings capture. Existing English completion toast predates language switch and is transient.

areas.purpose: Make local task ownership and recovery verifiable.
areas.actual_closure: Real download; original checksum verification; every task field equals IndexedDB before/after export and after reload; original initial/reloaded source-body hashes exact.
areas.evidence: Actual six downloads, raw DB snapshots, native report; final post-copy cross-check.
